name: Posadas
pointBasis: Exact WUP2025 settlement point; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The Dirección General de Catastro de la Provincia de Misiones is headquartered in Posadas and provides an official cadastral self-query/viewer route. The municipal IDE Posadas separately publishes the city geospatial portal and cadastral/parcel layers. This establishes official local/provincial custody and public service availability, not citywide completeness.
technicalBasis: The official municipal IDE GeoServer WFS returned anonymous GeoJSON MultiPolygon features from geonode:mae_29_publico in EPSG:4326 for a bounded bbox around the exact WUP point. The layer schema exposes fid, geometry, AdMapKey, and IDGIS; IDGIS was retained as the canonical native parcel identity. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal fields were requested or retained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Dirección General de Catastro de Misiones is the provincial cadastral custodian; IDE Posadas is the municipal geospatial portal; its public GeoServer WFS exposes a cadastral parcel layer.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Anonymous bounded WFS response with three complete MultiPolygon parcel geometries and stable-looking IDGIS identities near the WUP point.
